caption: The video segment begins with a black screen. Then, the scene transitions to an aerial view of a landscape from an airplane window. The camera pans across the terrain below, revealing fields and roads. Text appears on the screen, reading "PORTUGAL SPAIN FRANCE SIX WEEKS".

Text appears on the screen indicating that the footage was taken during a six-week trip in 2012 between Portugal, Spain, and France.
